name: pdk-pulpcore-domain-storage-quota
instr:
# Domain storage limits

Our tenants use separate Pulp domains and need a byte limit on stored files without disrupting delivery. Add a shared filesystem storage quota across the API, pulp_file workers and content app. Deliver source and migrations in `/app`.

## Requirements
- Domains accept `storage_quota`, nonnegative bytes or `null` for unlimited storage. Domain detail reports `storage_quota`, `used` and `reserved` in bytes: distinct stored artifacts, including pre-upgrade data, and promised bytes not yet stored, respectively.
- Direct `POST /artifacts/` refuses bytes beyond `used + reserved <= storage_quota`. Duplicate files count once; domains are independent. Lowering a quota below usage leaves files intact but blocks new bytes.
- `POST /uploads/` refuses declared sizes that do not fit, even across concurrent API instances. Chunks refresh the hold; commit converts it to usage and releases the rest; delete releases it. Abandoned holds expire within 45 seconds of the last chunk so capacity can be reused.
- Immediate pulp_file syncs reserve the bytes of every manifest file the domain has not stored yet, including content an earlier on-demand sync added without its file, before file downloads; oversized manifests fail without fetching file bytes. Holds block competing API uploads; saved artifacts consume them. Completion, failure, cancellation and worker death release unused space; capacity is reusable within 45 seconds of worker death.
